options.text: 6 year old girl, not disruptive. Doesn’t cause trouble at home. Only pays attention to teacher when she speaks face to face up close. Doesn’t pay attention during reading time in class. All gross motor/fine motor skills normal milestones. Plays well. Delayed speech, knows colours. Has 20 words but does not form sentences, only 4 word phrases.
3 year old, shy, quiet. Does not make eye contact well, loves Thomas the tank engine. Does not like it when people move his Thomas the tank engine out of the line with the other trains. Does not talk
